title: 15 Work From Home Jobs for 12th Pass in India 2026
summary: Real roles that don't need a degree, reported pay, what you need to start, and how to avoid scams.
body_markdown:
The best work from home jobs for 12th pass in India are selling financial products with GroMo, telecalling, customer support, data entry and tele-sales. None of these needs a degree; most need a smartphone or laptop, stable internet and clear communication. Work from home pay usually runs about ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 a month (WorkIndia, retrieved 2026-11-06). Graduates can also see our[work from home jobs for freshers](https://gromo.in/blog/work-from-home-jobs-for-freshers/) .


Below are 15 jobs for 12th pass candidates with the skills each needs and how to apply. Pay figures come from job listings and are rough, so check your offer. Most companies and GroMo also need you to be 18 or older.


# Job Starting cost Skills needed Best for


1 Selling Financial Products With GroMo None Basic phone use; free training in the app Anyone 18 or older


2 Telecaller None Hindi or a regional language Confident speakers


3 Customer Support Executive None Clear language, basic computer use People with patience


4 Tele-Sales Executive None Persuasion, calling People who enjoy selling


5 Data Entry Operator None Typing, accuracy Fast, careful typists


6 Back Office Executive None Computer basics, Excel Organised people


7 E-commerce Seller Assistant None Computer basics People who shop online a lot


8 Content Writer (Hindi or English) None Good writing People who write well


9 Social Media Assistant None Instagram, Canva People good with reels


10 Online Reseller Low Selling People with a big friend circle


11 Tutor for Younger Children None Strong school basics Students with good marks


12 Graphic Designer Very low Canva Creative people


13 Video Editor Low An editing app People who enjoy making videos


14 Transcription Worker None Listening, typing Careful listeners


15 Commission Sales Partner None Selling, follow-up People who want flexibility


Starting-cost labels are our own rough estimates: None, Very low, Low, Medium and High. Actual costs depend on your city and setup.


How this list is ranked: GroMo comes first because you can start the same day with no interview. The rest follow the roles that Indian job boards list most often for 12th pass candidates, with the easiest to get placed higher.


## 1. Selling Financial Products With GroMo: Bank-paid commissions, no stock


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Basic phone use; free training in the app | **Best for:** Anyone 18 or older


Selling financial products with GroMo tops this list because it costs nothing to start and needs only a smartphone. GroMo is a free app where you help people apply for credit cards, savings accounts, loans and demat accounts from partner banks, and you earn a commission when the application is approved. On GroMo, credit cards pay up to ₹2,000, savings accounts up to ₹1,000, demat accounts up to ₹450, and personal loans up to 4.5% of the loan amount (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). It needs no degree or interview, only a smartphone and the free training, and it's a way to build real sales skills early. The pay is commission only, with no fixed salary, and only approved applications earn; you must be 18 or older.


How to start:


1. Download the GroMo app and register free with your phone number.
2. Finish the one-time verification and the free in-app training.
3. Share a product link with someone who genuinely needs it, then track the application in the app.


## 2. Telecaller: The most common role


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Hindi or a regional language | **Best for:** Confident speakers


Telecalling is the most common work from home job for 12th pass candidates. Listings we saw ranged from about ₹8,000 to ₹12,000 up to ₹20,000 or more a month, depending on the employer (WorkIndia, retrieved 2026-11-06). Check targets before you accept.


How to start:


1. Check the company and get a written offer.
2. Ask about targets and fixed pay.
3. Keep a quiet calling space.


## 3. Customer Support Executive: Chat and voice support


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Clear language, basic computer use | **Best for:** People with patience


Customer support roles often accept 12th pass candidates, with training provided. Voice and chat roles usually need a laptop and steady internet, and English skills can open better-paying roles.


How to start:


1. Apply on company careers pages.
2. Practise a mock support call.
3. Check shift times before joining.


## 4. Tele-Sales Executive: Fixed pay plus incentive


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Persuasion, calling | **Best for:** People who enjoy selling


Tele-sales adds incentives on top of a fixed base, which rewards good performance but creates pressure. Read the target clause carefully; our guide to[work from home sales jobs](https://gromo.in/blog/work-from-home-sales-jobs/) explains how these pay structures work.


How to start:


1. Learn a simple sales call structure.
2. Compare fixed pay and targets.
3. Get the terms in writing.


## 5. Data Entry Operator: Typing and records


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Typing, accuracy | **Best for:** Fast, careful typists


Data entry suits people with fast, accurate typing, but one career guide calls it the most scam-prone job type (JobRise, retrieved 2026-11-06). Apply only through known companies, and never pay a fee or deposit for typing work.


How to start:


1. Test your typing speed.
2. Apply through verified listings only.
3. Refuse any offer asking for payment.


## 6. Back Office Executive: Records and coordination


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Computer basics, Excel | **Best for:** Organised people


Back office staff manage records, emails and basic coordination. Remote roles exist with smaller companies, and basic Excel makes your application stronger. Free online tutorials can get you started in a few weeks.


How to start:


1. Learn Excel basics for free.
2. Apply to small companies.
3. Ask whether the role is fully remote.


## 7. E-commerce Seller Assistant: Help online sellers


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Computer basics | **Best for:** People who shop online a lot


Seller assistants list products, update prices and handle orders for small online sellers. Local sellers often need part-time help, and this work teaches you skills you could later use for your own store.


How to start:


1. Learn how product listings work.
2. Message small sellers in your area.
3. Offer a one-week trial.


## 8. Content Writer (Hindi or English): Write for websites


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Good writing | **Best for:** People who write well


Content writing doesn't need a degree; your samples decide everything. Hindi writers have a real market, and you can start with small blog and social media jobs on freelancing sites. Women can see more options in[work from home jobs for women](https://gromo.in/blog/work-from-home-jobs-for-women/) .


How to start:


1. Write three samples.
2. Create a freelancing profile.
3. Start with small paid jobs.


## 9. Social Media Assistant: Post for local shops


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Instagram, Canva | **Best for:** People good with reels


Local shops and coaching centres need help posting on Instagram. You can start with one nearby business, and a page you've already grown yourself is better proof than any degree or certificate.


How to start:


1. Build a small sample page.
2. Pitch to two or three local shops.
3. Charge a small monthly fee.


## 10. Online Reseller: Sell on WhatsApp


**Starting cost:** Low | **Skills:** Selling | **Best for:** People with a big friend circle


Reselling lets you earn a margin on products you share on WhatsApp and Instagram. Take payment first and then order from the supplier, so you aren't stuck with unsold stock.


How to start:


1. Pick one product category.
2. Share products on WhatsApp Status.
3. Order after the customer pays.


## 11. Tutor for Younger Children: Teach primary classes


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Strong school basics | **Best for:** Students with good marks


Tutoring primary school children is possible with just a 12th pass if you're strong in the subject. Parents care about results, so start with one or two local children and let word of mouth grow your batch. More student ideas are in our[business ideas for students](https://gromo.in/blog/business-ideas-for-students/) .


How to start:


1. Offer to teach one or two local children.
2. Prepare a simple weekly plan.
3. Ask parents to recommend you.


## 12. Graphic Designer: Posters and social posts


**Starting cost:** Very low | **Skills:** Canva | **Best for:** Creative people


Graphic design has no degree requirement; clients want to see good samples. Canva is enough for posters and social media posts, and college fests and small shops are good sources of first orders.


How to start:


1. Make five samples in Canva.
2. Share them on Instagram.
3. Pitch to shops and local events.


## 13. Video Editor: Edit reels and short videos


**Starting cost:** Low | **Skills:** An editing app | **Best for:** People who enjoy making videos


Video editing is in demand because creators post short videos often. You can learn the basics on a phone app, and your samples will matter more than your education when you pitch to creators.


How to start:


1. Learn one free editing app.
2. Edit three sample reels.
3. Send them to small creators.


## 14. Transcription Worker: Audio to text


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Listening, typing | **Best for:** Careful listeners


Transcription turns audio into text and is usually paid per project. It's useful as a first income, but one guide warns these lower-tier tasks aren't long-term plans (Levelop, retrieved 2026-11-06), so keep learning other skills too.


How to start:


1. Practise with free audio clips.
2. Take a platform's test.
3. Keep building a stronger skill.


## 15. Commission Sales Partner: Earn per sale from home


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Selling, follow-up | **Best for:** People who want flexibility


Commission sales roles pay you per sale with no degree needed. Our guide to[commission based jobs](https://gromo.in/blog/commission-based-jobs/) lists the common options. Stay away from any role that makes you pay to join or buy stock.


How to start:


1. Check who pays you, and for what.
2. Avoid any role with a joining fee.
3. Track your leads and follow up.


## How Much Does GroMo Pay for Each Product?


Product on GroMo Pays partners up to


SBI Credit Card ₹2,000 per approved card


HDFC Secured Credit Card ₹1,750 per approved card


Axis Saving Account ₹1,000 per account


Digi Credit Personal Loan 4.5% of the loan amount


Kotak 811 Super Account ₹600 per account


Kotak Securities Demat Account ₹450 per account


The SBI Credit Card pays partners up to ₹2,000 per approved card (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). Commission is paid only on approval.


The Axis Saving Account pays up to ₹1,000 per successful account (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). Many other products pay less.


The Digi Credit Personal Loan pays up to 4.5% of the loan amount, and most other lenders pay less (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). Check the live payout in the app.


## What is the salary of a work from home job for 12th pass?


Work from home jobs for 12th pass candidates usually pay around ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 a month, with freshers often starting lower and strong sellers earning more through incentives (WorkIndia, retrieved 2026-11-06). Offers far above this range, such as lakhs a month for simple work, are a warning sign. Always get the pay in writing.


## Can you get a work from home job after 12th with no experience?


Yes, you can get a work from home job after 12th with no experience, because telecalling, customer support and data entry often include training. A clean resume, clear speech and basic computer skills are usually enough. If you're also studying, part-time options in our guide to[online part-time jobs for students](https://gromo.in/blog/online-part-time-jobs-for-students/) may fit better.


## What do you need to work from home after 12th?


You'll need a smartphone or laptop, stable internet, a quiet place, a bank account, and PAN and Aadhaar for KYC. Calling jobs also need good headphones. Most companies hire from age 18, so check the age requirement before applying.


## How do you avoid fake jobs for 12th pass?


Avoid any job that charges a registration fee, sells a typing kit, or promises high pay for simple tasks. Scammers target 12th pass candidates because they want quick income. Check the company's website, ask for an offer letter, and never share your OTP.


**GroMo** is a free app where partners help customers apply for credit cards, loans, savings accounts and demat accounts from partner banks, and earn a commission on approval.


## FAQ: Work from Home Jobs for 12Th Pass


### Which work from home job is best for 12th pass?


Telecalling and customer support are the most common. If you're 18 or older and want to start without an interview, selling financial products with GroMo is another option.


### Can I do a work from home job after 12th without a laptop?


Yes. Telecalling, selling financial products and reselling can run from a smartphone. Many support and data roles need a laptop.


### How much does a 12th pass earn from work from home jobs?


Reported pay is about ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 a month, and freshers often start lower. Pay depends on the role and company.


### Is 12th pass enough for customer support jobs?


Many customer support roles accept 12th pass candidates, especially with good communication skills, but check each listing.


### Can a 17-year-old do a work from home job?


Many companies hire from 18, and GroMo needs you to be 18 or older. Younger students can tutor or do small tasks with a parent's guidance.


### Are typing jobs for 12th pass real?


Some are, but many are scams. Don't pay a fee or buy a kit, and apply only through known companies.


GroMo (Vitrak Technologies Pvt Ltd) is a distribution platform. GroMo isn't a bank, NBFC, insurer or investment adviser. All products are offered by their respective RBI, IRDAI or SEBI-regulated providers.


Partner earnings depend on effort, product mix and customer eligibility. Any figures shown are illustrative. They aren't typical and aren't promised.


Sources: Top-ranking sources checked: WorkIndia listings, JobRise and Levelop, retrieved 2026-11-06. GroMo product catalogue, commission rates by product, retrieved 2026-11-06.


## Disclaimer


GroMo doesn't promise any level of income. Commissions are set by partner banks, vary by product and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications; check the live commission in the GroMo app. Starting-cost labels are our own rough estimates, and any pay figures from other sites or job listings are what those sources state, not a guarantee. GroMo is available only to users aged 18 and above. Everything above is general information, not financial, legal or career advice.
